changeSet.author: Eugene Smith
changeSet.comment:
Who invited whom. referred_by is a snapshot of the moment the account was created and never changes afterwards — an existing user following somebody's link must not be re-attributed, and that rule lives in the code, not in this DDL.
Existing rows get their code from the database because the column is NOT NULL; new ones get an eight-character Crockford base32 code from the application. The two shapes differ on purpose and it costs nothing: a code is opaque and is only ever looked up by equality.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE users SET referral_code = upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12)) WHERE referral_code IS NULL
